prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent production sprite sheet, three genuine full-body working views of the existing DEVOPS companion.
Input images: image 1 (devops-v2.png) is the PRIMARY identity, adult anatomy, physical head size, clothes and body-proportion reference. Image 2 (devops.png) supplies ONLY the three top-row work directions/hand-tool ideas; its short body proportions are WRONG and must be corrected.
Primary request: redraw exactly three adult female DEVOPS working figures in a single horizontal row, no other figures. Preserve the original 25+ adult woman's long torso, long thighs/shins, natural head/face size, slim cinched waist, blue undercut with cyan forelock, orange headphones resting on the collar, navy mechanic jumpsuit with cyan piping, gloves, orange multimeter, belts and black/cyan work boots.
Directions left to right: 1) genuine FRONT LEFT THREE-QUARTER, torso angled toward screen-left, both gloved hands checking the orange meter at chest height; 2) true LEFT SIDE PROFILE with the face/nose pointing screen-left and full leftward torso profile, same meter and leads; 3) BACK LEFT THREE-QUARTER with the back visible, body pointing away and toward screen-left, head turned slightly toward the left shoulder, checking the meter. Do not mirror one figure to create another.
Critical anatomy correction: all three stand upright at the SAME physical adult height with the SAME pelvis and shoulder levels and identical head scale; draw a longer torso and longer legs than image2. Approximately 6.5 head-heights tall like image1, never chibi or squashed. Do NOT enlarge the heads to fill space. Standing knee flexion only slight; all three have the same camera, distance and zoom. Boots share one baseline; top of hair also aligns. Keep exactly the original haircut and the same face/eye dimensions as image1. Headphones and clothing sit on the torso; the head is cleanly distinct above the collar.
Style: crisp high-quality anime pixel sprite illustration, preserve the original identity and navy/cyan/orange palette, defined cel-shaded volume and detailed hands. Same soft upper-left lighting for all three.
Composition: wide landscape sheet, only three full-length separate figures in equal cells. Every hair tip, glove, multimeter lead and boot fully visible. Generous transparent gutters and at least 35 pixels of blank margin all around; no figure touching the border.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha channel, no visible or hidden scenic objects, no shadow floor, no rectangle, no text, no labels, no grid, no checkerboard drawn into pixels.
Avoid: child/chibi anatomy, small legs, shortened torso, enlarged round head, different costumes, duplicate angles, mirrored tools, distorted fingers, dangling detached pieces, cropped feet.
